Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.controller

Class ControllerImpl

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.controller.ControllerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Controller
public class ControllerImpl extends Object implements Controller
It has a list of LobbiesControllers and Clients. It allows to create or delete a lobby, add a client, join a lobby and connect the correct client who joined it and quit.

    • createLobby

      public LobbyController createLobby(Client client, ServerConnectionHandler connectionHandler, String playerName, String lobbyName)
      Creates a Lobby where the players can enter to play the game. Automatically connects the creator to it. It checks if the username and the lobby name are valid names. Notifies the Client's ClientExceptionNotifier if the lobby has already been created
      Specified by:
      createLobby in interface Controller
      Parameters:
      client - is the client representing the player who's connecting.
      connectionHandler - is the ServerConnectionHandler used for the player's connection.
      playerName - is the name of this first player which is now the room owner and created this lobby.
      lobbyName - is the name of the created lobby.
      Returns:
      null if the creation fails, the lobbyController of the created lobby otherwise.

    • joinLobby

      public LobbyController joinLobby(Client client, ServerConnectionHandler connectionHandler, String playerName, String lobbyName)
      Allows a player, that is not the first one to enter the game, to join an existing lobby. If the lobby doesn't exist it notifies the Client's ClientExceptionNotifier.
      Specified by:
      joinLobby in interface Controller
      Parameters:
      client - the client representing the player who's connecting.
      connectionHandler - the ServerConnectionHandler used for the player's connection.
      playerName - the name of the player that wants to join this lobby.
      lobbyName - the name of the joined lobby.
      Returns:
      null if connection fails, the lobbyController otherwise
